rules_summary.intra_state: When Supplier State == Place of Supply: Apply equal CGST + SGST (e.g. 9% + 9% for 18%). IGST must be 0.
rules_summary.inter_state: When Supplier State != Place of Supply: Apply IGST in full (e.g. 18%). CGST and SGST must be 0.
rules_summary.rounding_rule: Section 170 of CGST Act mandates rounding of tax, interest, penalty to nearest rupee (fraction < 50p discarded, >= 50p rounded to 1 rupee). Discrepancy > 1.00 is an audit violation.
